extracted.intended_audience: readers of Nature: scientists, students, academic job applicants, and buyers of scientific instruments and educational collections
extracted.subtask_description: A supplement to the journal Nature containing advertisements, equipment specifications, product guarantees, and academic/staffing notices (scholarships, studentships, appointments). It provides procedural application requirements, product specifications, and service terms aimed at scientific readers and institutions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sales viewing and schedule
rubrics_metrics.description: SALENS are held EVERY FRIDAY, at his Rooms, 38 King Street, Covent Garden, London, W.C. On view Thursday 3 to 5 and morning of Sale.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies the regular sale day and the public inspection/viewing times (Thursday 3–5 and the morning of the sale) for microscopes, slides, objectives, telescopes, photographic apparatus, household furniture, jewellery, and other miscellaneous property.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specimen identification and documentation
rubrics_metrics.description: Each specimen is numbered, corresponding to a carefully prepared printed list giving name and scientific description of the different forms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requirement for crystal/sample sets sold for teaching: individual numbering linked to a printed list ensures identification and correct scientific description for student/institution use.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quality guarantee and returns policy for collections
rubrics_metrics.description: If the collection is unsatisfactory, return at our expense within ten days of receipt, and we will immediately refund your money in full. We take the risk of loss or breakage and cost of double transport.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Seller offers a 10-day satisfaction guarantee with full refund and assumes costs/risks of transport and breakage; institutions may pay after delivery according to their rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Instrument accuracy and specification (Anglemeter)
rubrics_metrics.description: One-fifth of a degree can be easily read by this device.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicit accuracy claim for Becker's/Erskine Murray's 'Anglemeter' used for teaching mathematics, practical geography and surveying; accompanied by usage procedures (e.g., set pinhole to 45°; hold instrument in vertical plane; sight spot on object; pace backwards until reflection aligns) illustrating how to obtain measurements (single observation for accessible objects; two readings and base line for inaccessible objects).

rubrics_metrics.name: Instrument usage procedure (Anglemeter surveying methods)
rubrics_metrics.description: When objects are seen in the mirror the angle made by its direction with the line of sight is twice that through which the radial arm is moved ... For measuring heights one observation suffices if the object is accessible (procedure: set pinhole to 45°, sight a spot level with eye, pace backwards until top reflection aligns). If inaccessible, a second reading with a measured baseline is necessary.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives step-by-step procedural guidance and illustrative examples (measuring pole height; surveying between two chimneys) that instruct users how to obtain angles and compute distances/heights using the instrument.

rubrics_metrics.name: Instrument construction and student-use features (Resistance Box)
rubrics_metrics.description: This set of coils has been made specially for teaching purposes. Students can see all coils and connections, as the case is a thick glass cylinder, ebonite top, heavy blocks, well-fitting plugs, and mahogany base. Coils adjusted to 1/2%, 1 ohm to 100 ohms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies pedagogical design (transparent case to view connections, robust materials) and electrical tolerances (adjusted to 1/2%) and resistance range for teaching laboratory equipment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Product testimonial as evidence of usefulness
rubrics_metrics.description: COPIES OF TESTIMONIALS RECEIVED. 'I think that your little instrument would prove useful in schools.' — JOHN PERRY ... 'I am much interested in the admirable little surveying instrument ...' — WILLIAM ROBINSON.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use of reputable institutional/professional testimonials (Royal College of Science; named professors) to validate pedagogical value and suitability of instruments for schools and students.

rubrics_metrics.name: Studentship eligibility, scope, and renewal terms (Mackinnon Research Studentships)
rubrics_metrics.description: Two Studentships each of the value of £150. One is awarded for research in the group of the Physical Sciences ... the other is awarded for research in the group of the Biological Sciences ... The Studentships are awarded annually for one year, but are renewable for a second year. Under exceptional circumstances they may be renewed for a third year. The Studentships are restricted to British subjects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligibility limited by discipline grouping and nationality (British subjects); term length and renewal policy stated; applications have a deadline and further particulars obtainable from the Royal Society's Assistant Secretary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scholarship award criteria and matriculation requirement (University of Manchester medical scholarships)
rubrics_metrics.description: Two Scholarships are offered and will be awarded to candidates who give evidence of a high standard of proficiency in Arts or Science respectively. Each Scholarship is in the name of ... and the successful candidate will be required to matriculate for the full medical curriculum in the University and the Infirmary.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selection based on demonstrated high proficiency in specified subjects; successful candidates must matriculate for the full medical curriculum — a condition of scholarship tenure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Course recognition and scope (St. Mary's Medical School)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Medical School provides courses of instruction covering the ENTIRE MEDICAL CURRICULUM for the Degrees of the Universities and for the Diplomas of M.R.C.S., L.R.C.P. All courses are recognised by the University of London for its internal students.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Asserted institutional recognition and comprehensiveness of curriculum — criterion for prospective students selecting courses that meet degree/diploma requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Overseas teaching appointment eligibility and conditions (Ministry of Education, Egypt assistant masters)
rubrics_metrics.description: ASSISTANT MASTERS WANTED ... Candidates should not be less than 13 nor over 30 years of age, have a robust constitution, and have taken a University Degree in Honours. They must have experience as teachers: preference will be given to applicants who hold a diploma in teaching. Salary, allowances, leave, and application instructions given.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies age, health, academic qualification (University degree in honours), teaching experience, and preference for pedagogical diploma as eligibility criteria; also specifies commencement date, salary, and application procedure/deadline.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application materials and submission rules for academic posts (Oxford Professorship of Pathology example)
rubrics_metrics.description: Candidates are requested to send their applications to the Registrar of the University on or before July 1. No testimonials are to be submitted, but Candidates should send in, with their names, ten copies of a statement of their qualifications, accompanied by references or any other evidence they may desire to offer.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines explicit application format (no testimonials; required ten copies of a qualifications statement), deadline, and allowed supporting evidence; also states duties (lecturing, laboratory charge) and restriction (not allowed to engage in private medical or surgical practice).

rubrics_metrics.name: Academic appointment qualification and experience requirements (Demonstrator / Assistant Lecturer posts)
rubrics_metrics.description: Examples: 'Candidates for the Science Scholarships must have passed the London Matriculation or its equivalent.' 'Candidates must be University graduates with teaching experience, and have also had some practical experience.' 'Applications, furnishing particulars of professional and technical training, experience in teaching and organisation, together with copies of three recent testimonials, references, etc., should be forwarded.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Common hiring criteria across advertised academic posts include university degrees, demonstrated teaching experience, practical/technical experience where relevant, and submission of particulars and testimonials/references by stated deadlines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scholarship examination subjects and prerequisites (Northern Polytechnic Institute example)
rubrics_metrics.description: 6 ENTRANCE SCHOLARSHIPS EACH ... Giving free tuition and money payments up to £9 per annum. The subjects of examination will be MATHEMATICS, ENGLISH, and either PHYSICS or CHEMISTRY. Candidates for the Science Scholarships must have passed the London Matriculation or its equivalent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies exam subjects, financial terms, and required prior qualifications (London Matriculation) for applicants to competitive entrance scholarships; includes exam dates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advertising charging rules and typographic billing
rubrics_metrics.description: Three Lines in Column ... Per Line after ... The first Line being in heavy type is charged for as Two Lines. Cheques and Money Orders payable to MACMILLAN & CO., Limited.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets explicit pricing rules for advertisements including column/line rates and a special rule that a first line in heavy type counts as two lines — a billing standard advertisers must follow.

rubrics_metrics.name: Catalogues, price lists, and free literature availability
rubrics_metrics.description: Illustrated Catalogue (printed free on application) ... Descriptive Leaflet on application ... Illustrated Catalogues of Spectroscopes or Telescopes post free. Price list on application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practice of supplying catalogues, illustrated literature, and price lists free on request — standard sales/marketing and procurement information for institutional buyers.
